name: Accurate Handling
effect: You gain +1 Accuracy to all Ranged attacks.
description: An improvement to your mech's ability to handle ranged weapons allows it to have a better chance at hitting targets.

name: High Priority Systems
effect: You gain +5 SP at the cost of -1 Stress.
description: RTC has developed a way to allow for more systems to be installed into mechs at the cost of reactor stability.

name: Improved Systems Accuracy
effect: You gain +1 Accuracy on all Engineering and Systems checks and saves.
description: An improvement to your mech's internals gives it a greater chance in certain situations.

name: Prototype Reactor
effect: You gain +5 Heat Cap and the cost for Overcharge is always 1d6 Heat.
description: A prototype reactor designed with the hope to handle heat more efficiently.

name: Prototype Sensors
effect: You may choose to roll 4d6 upon entering a Scene, however, your base Sensor range is replaced by this value until the end of the Scene.
description: New prototype mech sensors being developed by RTC. They have great potential but are not always reliable.

actions.name: Activate Prototype Sensors
actions.detail: You may roll a 4d6, your base Sensor range is replaced by the result until the end of the Scene.

name: Redundant Sensory Systems
effect: You gain Immunity to Impaired and Jammed.
description: Your mech now comes with backup communication and sensory systems in the case primaries fail.
